basis: Actual accepted verifier; first representative only proved per selected family. Coverage is framing/length shape, not recursive dataflow verification.
prior_wrapper_gap: Frozen v1 checked public length only; canonical IV/counts were provided in artifacts but not universally required by its wrapper. Bounded v2 enforces strict raw integer byte digest plus fixed standard IV/count tail. Root separately hardens earlier wrapper.
limits: Raw source-cell extrapolation excludes auxiliaries, FFT, hash commitments, transcript and routing witness
No complete recursive verifier, zero-knowledge, QROM or128-bit security claim
Only one actual representative per family has or will have component proof evidence; no multiplication of proof-size into a secure full-verifier estimate
